context_policy: rank order, deduplicate, skip blocks that do not fit

configs.name: tfidf
configs.hypothesis: Lexical matching may retrieve precise terms.

configs.name: hybrid_rrf
configs.hypothesis: Combining rankings may improve evidence retrieval.

configs.name: dense_more_context
configs.hypothesis: More chunks may retain supporting evidence.

metrics: Gold quote match at source/page; q11 requires both IDs. Unanswerable cases excluded from retrieval denominators. Errors remain in answerable denominators as misses.
selection_rule: After source review and real-agent evaluation: prioritize grounded answer quality, then context evidence, then Hit@3, then lower measured cost and latency. Do not use test to tune.
limitations: No answer model, citation grading or abstention grading yet. Gold alternatives may be incomplete. Cached and uncached latencies must not be treated as equivalent.
